name: MASIC (Mohammed I. Alsubeaei & Sons Investment Company)

source.detail: Explicitly established to exclusively manage the assets of the family of the late Mohammed I. Alsubeaei — a single family office by its own definition, running public equity, private equity and real estate at multi-billion-dollar scale. It has professionalised: the family moved off day-to-day management onto the board, which means an executive team makes the operating decisions. LEI 558600CPLKVWVHAITJ95, GLEIF ACTIVE, Riyadh. Evidence: https://www.worldfinance.com/strategy/managerial-roles-diversify-at-investment-firm-masic-2
